title: Watch renders the dashboard frame
description:
Epic hn6, wave 3: rewrite the `ticfac watch` frame renderer (internal/cli/watch_view.go) into the dashboard layout. It stays a PURE function of the status model plus the pane's width and height, testable headless as render-to-string at a fixed width. There is no terminal, pty or herdr in its tests.

Input: statusmodel.Model with the hn6 fields (per-tick pipeline, parent_tick_id, duration_seconds, tries[].tier/reason/next_step, workers[].activity/handle, health.verdict, cost.lines, recent, epic_title, tick gloss). Read their doc comments in internal/statusmodel/statusmodel.go. internal/statusmodel/contract.json has a golden named "dashboard" with every field populated: decode it in your tests.

Target layout (the hn6 spec; exact glyphs negotiable, the order is not):
```
6in ticfac takeover of what ticks drops            local · alive
███████████████████░░░░ 5/6 ticks · 12h24m · ETA ~40m · ● healthy (recovered: net ×14, sleep 41m)
plan ✓ waves ✓ review ✓ close-out ◐ ci ◐ merge ○          needs you: nothing

TICK  WHAT                              TIER      PIPELINE                          TIME   ATTEMPTS
060   cloud worker early-exit nudge     strong    claim ▸ work ▸ gate ▸ merged ✓    49m    1
46x   port sandbox verbs to ticfac      frontier  claim ▸ work ▸ gate ▸ merged ✓    1h39m  2 ⤴
v7z   close out phase 7                 closeout  claim ▸ work ▸ ●ci ▸ …            1h12m  2
 └ 823 repair: tk 0.32 width tests      frontier  claim ▸ work ▸ gate ▸ merged ✓    2h03m  2 ⤴

WORKERS                                       ACTIVITY (10m)   LAST
v7z  claude opus · tick-v7z-a11               ▁▃▅█▇▅▃▁▂▅       ran go test ./internal/reconcile (42s ago)

CI #98  go ◐ 6m · go race ✓ · ts ✓ · contracts ✓        cost  Workers AI $0.41 · claude not metered
─ recent ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
19:12 v7z gate passed on 9a1c…
19:04 fold resolved 2 conflicts                                  [e] events  [enter] tick
```
Rules this implements:
1. Rows never move. There is one row per tick, in plan order (waves in order, the tracker's order inside a wave), and children are indented (" └ ") under the row named by parent_tick_id. A tick's row never changes position between frames; only its cells change. The PIPELINE cell fills left to right: a done stage is plain, the active one bold with "●", a failed one red with "✗", and every pending stage after the active one is one dim "…". A closed tick ends "merged ✓" (or "closed ✓" for a role tick). ATTEMPTS is len(tries), plus " ⤴" when the tier changed between the first and the last try.
2. Attention first and quiet when empty. "needs you: nothing" is dim. A needs_person attention shows amber in the header, on its own line, as "needs you: <what> — <unblock_command>".
3. Health as a verdict: health.verdict.state is green "● healthy", amber "● degraded: …" or red "● stopped: …". It is followed by "(recovered: net ×14, sleep 41m)" from verdict.recovered, where seconds render through humanDuration and a null seconds renders as "×count". Raw counters are NOT shown.
4. ETA: "ETA ~<humanDuration(remaining.approximate_seconds)>" only when remaining is non-null.
5. Workers: one row per worker. It shows the model and executor (from the worker's tick), the handle, a sparkline of activity.buckets (▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ scaled to the max bucket; all zero → "··········"), last_action with its age, and an amber "nudged ×N" when nudges > 0. When workers is null (a cloud run), one dim line: "workers run in the cloud — not visible from here".
6. The tail: m.Recent's last 2 events through the existing watchEventLine (internal/cli/watch.go; call it, do not edit it), under a "─ recent" rule, with the key hint "[e] events  [enter] tick" at the right.
7. Cost: one segment per cost.lines entry, labelled Workers AI / claude / pi (local) / decisions / other. A metered line prints "$%.2f"; an unmetered one prints "not metered". The string "$0.00" must NEVER appear for an unmetered line. With no lines at all, print "cost not metered".
8. CI: "CI #<pr> <check> <✓|✗|◐ age>" per m.CI.Checks; a dim "CI: no PR yet" when m.CI is null.
Also fix the first-use typo: watchPlural("remote retry") printed "remote retrys". Make watchPlural pluralize a word ending in consonant+y as "ies", and add a test.

Width and height (the renderer must work in herdr panes and in plain terminals of any size):
- width ≥ 100: every column in full words.
- 64–99: PIPELINE becomes one glyph per stage (✓ done, ● active, ✗ failed, ○ pending), and LAST moves under the worker row.
- < 64: TIER and ATTEMPTS drop.
- < 48: WHAT drops.
- Every line is truncated to the width (ansi.Truncate, as today).
- Height > 0 and the frame too tall: the header, needs-you and tail are always kept. Closed rows collapse IN PLACE into one dim "✓ N closed" line per contiguous run of closed rows, so no row moves relative to another. If it is still too tall, the table ends with "+N more" (at most height lines total).
- Width 0 means unknown: render everything.

API: keep `renderWatchFrame(m statusmodel.Model, st watchStyles, width, height int, selected string) []string`. Add the `selected` parameter: the tick id whose row renders with a "▸" marker, "" for none. Update its call sites in internal/cli/watch.go to pass "" (that one-line change is the only edit allowed in watch.go). Also export, inside the package, `dashboardHeadline(m statusmodel.Model, st watchStyles, width int) []string`: the first three header lines. The bare overview reuses it in a later tick, so give it that name and signature exactly. Add a `green` style to watchStyles.

Files: internal/cli/watch_view.go, internal/cli/watch_view_test.go (rewrite for the new layout), new golden files internal/cli/testdata/watch_dashboard_120.txt and internal/cli/testdata/watch_dashboard_60.txt, the call-site change in internal/cli/watch.go, and assertions in internal/cli/watch_block_test.go / watch_test.go ONLY where they assert old frame text. Do not touch overview.go, internal/statusmodel or cloudflare/.

Tests (identity styles for the words, ANSI styles for one colour test):
- TestDashboardGolden: the contract's "dashboard" golden renders at width 120 and at width 60, and both match the testdata files byte-for-byte. Add a `-update` flag to regenerate them.
- TestDashboardRowsKeepTheirOrder: a model and a successor with states advanced → the tick-id column sequence is identical.
- TestDashboardNeedsYou: "needs you: nothing" with no attention, and the command shown with a hold.
- TestDashboardNeverPrintsZeroForUnmetered.
- TestDashboardVerdictColours.
- TestDashboardNarrowWidths at 99, 63 and 47: the columns drop as specified, and no line is wider than the width.
- TestDashboardFitsHeight at 12 lines: closed rows collapse in place.
- TestWatchPluralRetries.

Run: `go test -short -timeout 20m -run 'TestDashboard|TestWatchPlural|TestTheFrame|TestWatch' ./internal/cli/`. Must still pass: `go test -short -timeout 20m ./internal/cli/`, and then `make gate`.
acceptance_criteria: [1] renderWatchFrame draws the hn6 layout (header with progress/ETA/verdict/phase bar/needs-you, a tick table whose rows never reorder with a pipeline cell, workers with activity, CI and cost lines, a two-line recent tail) and matches testdata/watch_dashboard_120.txt and _60.txt. [2] `go test -short -timeout 20m -run 'TestDashboard|TestWatchPlural|TestTheFrame|TestWatch' ./internal/cli/` passes, including the narrow-width, height-fit, never-$0.00 and 'retries' cases. [3] `make gate` passes.
